name: Marking and Cutting
time_formula: (2 * (item.length_mm + item.width_mm)) * IF(input.raw_material.thickness_mm > 0, input.raw_material.thickness_mm, item.thickness_mm) / IF(machine.speed > 0, machine.speed, 15000)

name: CNC Drilling
time_formula: IF(item.num_holes > 0, item.num_holes, op.num_holes) / IF(machine.speed > 0, machine.speed, 2) * IF(input.raw_material.thickness_mm > 0, input.raw_material.thickness_mm / 16, 1)

name: Fit-up & I/H-Beam Assembly
time_formula: IF(item.weld_length_m > 0, item.weld_length_m, op.weld_length) / IF(machine.speed > 0, machine.speed, 0.3333) + inputs.count * 4

name: SAW Welding
time_formula: IF(item.weld_length_m > 0, item.weld_length_m, op.weld_length) / IF(machine.speed > 0, machine.speed, 0.5) * IF(input.raw_material.thickness_mm > 12, input.raw_material.thickness_mm / 12, 1)

name: Shot Blasting
time_formula: IF(item.surface_area_m2 > 0, item.surface_area_m2, IF(inputs.sum(surface_area_m2) > 0, inputs.sum(surface_area_m2), op.area_m2)) / IF(machine.speed > 0, machine.speed, 0.6667)

name: Metalizing
time_formula: IF(item.surface_area_m2 > 0, item.surface_area_m2, IF(inputs.sum(surface_area_m2) > 0, inputs.sum(surface_area_m2), op.area_m2)) / IF(machine.speed > 0, machine.speed, 0.5)

name: Painting
time_formula: IF(item.surface_area_m2 > 0, item.surface_area_m2, IF(inputs.sum(surface_area_m2) > 0, inputs.sum(surface_area_m2), op.area_m2)) / IF(machine.speed > 0, machine.speed, 0.8333)

name: Crane Move / Material Handling
time_formula: IF(item.unit_weight_kg > 0, 6 + item.unit_weight_kg / IF(machine.speed > 0, machine.speed, 400), IF(inputs.sum(unit_weight_kg) > 0, 6 + inputs.sum(unit_weight_kg) / IF(machine.speed > 0, machine.speed, 400), op.move_time))

name: Edge / Bevel Preparation
time_formula: IF(item.length_mm > 0, (2 * (item.length_mm + item.width_mm) / 1000), op.edge_length) / IF(machine.speed > 0, machine.speed, 0.5) * IF(input.raw_material.thickness_mm > 0, input.raw_material.thickness_mm / 16, 1)
